use_case: Consumer generative AI assistant used to research tariff classifications from invoice product descriptions and to draft client emails
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI assistant vendor (general-purpose large language model); free personal account; consumer terms allow training on chats
data_categories: Invoice line descriptions; in 31 of 152 chats whole invoices with client and supplier names and prices (client records under 19 CFR 111.24). No importer of record numbers or Social Security numbers found
affects_individuals: No (clients are businesses; the advice affects duty owed by importers, and the broker decides)
human_in_the_loop: The owner chooses every classification and checks it against the tariff schedule and CBP rulings before filing or advising; from 2026-09-14 the basis is recorded in the shipment file
applicable_laws: 19 CFR 111.24 (confidentiality; written client authorization); 19 CFR 111.28(a) (responsible supervision and control); 19 CFR 111.39(b) (due diligence in advice); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) if personal information were ever entered
status: Approved (with conditions due 2026-10-31; client data paused until met)

use_case: Document capture in the customs software: extracts invoice lines (description, quantity, value, origin) into draft entry lines
vendor_or_model: Customs software vendor (built-in machine learning extraction; covered by the vendor contract and SOC 2 report)
data_categories: Commercial invoices and packing lists (client records)
human_in_the_loop: The owner checks every extracted line against the invoice before transmitting the entry
applicable_laws: 19 CFR 111.28(a); 19 CFR 111.24 (vendor named in the client authorization)
